note: Missouri Department of Conservation upland area of grassland, ponds and woods along the Little Platte River south of Plattsburg. MDC's primitive camping area is a mowed grass clearing beside the gravel parking lot at the end of the area's improved road from Route C; no defined sites or amenities. Fires are allowed only in the designated camping area; ponds are electric motors only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: map-designated primitive camping beside the parking lot at the end of the MDC improved road (GIS 533, ~60 m from lot 3251) on mowed grass. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin fine; phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK (lot-side designated area, padless): area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map' and 'Fires permitted only in designated camping areas'; the 2022 area map draws the single 'Primitive Camping' symbol directly beside the parking lot at the end of the 'MDC Improved Road'; GIS 27 point 533 'Primitive Camping Area'. Rule 140 standard (the rules.py 'EXTRA: 20' was the area id 201120, not a rule); no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN fine: stored 39.54322,-94.42281 = GIS 533, on a mowed grass clearing ~60 m south of gravel lot 3251 at the end of the area road; there is no pad, so a rig parks on the lot edge or the grass beside it. Optional tweak to the lot's south edge, 39.5437,-94.4226 (~55 m).
HORSES: brochure 'No horseback riding opportunities exist except on public roadways.' - no horse camp. CLUSTERS: one camping symbol; four lots.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (nearest pond ~250 m; the river ~600 m NE).
